title: Jest
description: A delightful JavaScript testing framework with a focus on simplicity.

data.text: Jest is a zero-configuration testing framework for JavaScript maintained by Meta. It includes an assertion library, mocking utilities, and a test runner — all in one package. Jest works with React, Node.js, and most JavaScript projects.
